concern: (low) Consider fine-tuning touch target padding on mobile navigation elements for enhanced Fitts Law hit area compliance.
jtbd: When navigating the application on a mobile device or touch screen, I want navigation links to have an adequate hit area (minimum 44x44px per Fitts's Law and WCAG touch target recommendations), so that I can reliably activate destinations without accidental mis-taps.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the header navigation viewed on a 375px mobile viewport, When measuring the clickable bounding box of each navigation link in the header nav, Then each interactive target has a minimum touch target size of 44px by 44px with at least 8px spacing between adjacent touch targets.
editInstruction: In design/approved/20261118162522-mockup/mockup.html, locate the <nav role="navigation" aria-label="Main Navigation"> element inside <header role="banner">. Replace class 'p-1' on each of the navigation <a> links with 'py-2.5 px-3 min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] inline-flex items-center justify-center' to ensure a minimum 44px hit area conforming to Fitts's Law.
